# SIURI Defence Physical Academy

> SIURI Defence Physical Academy provides structured physical and written preparation for candidates preparing for Defence, Paramilitary, Police and other Government recruitment examinations.

## About

SIURI Defence Physical Academy is a Section 8 Company / Non-Profit Organisation (CIN: U85499WR2026NPL297011) founded by Sayan Pal. Based in Suri, Birbhum, West Bengal, we provide disciplined training, proper guidance, regular practice and personal attention to help candidates improve their physical fitness and academic preparation.

## Services

- Physical Training: Rigorous physical drills, running, push-ups, sit-ups and endurance training
- Written Classes: Comprehensive academic preparation covering GK, Maths, English
- Weekly Mock Tests: Full-length simulated exams with performance analysis
- Medical Guidance: Medical check-up and health monitoring
- Hostel Facility: Comfortable accommodation with disciplined routine
- Online Classes: Live interactive digital learning platform

## Recruitment Preparation

- Indian Army / Agniveer
- BSF (Border Security Force)
- CISF (Central Industrial Security Force)
- CRPF (Central Reserve Police Force)
- SSB (Sashastra Seema Bal)
- SSC GD (Staff Selection Commission General Duty)
- Police (State and Central)
- Air Force
- Navy
- Railways
